description: STAGE-CONSISTENCY BASELINE for saga #811 (issue #816 item 5): the `check()` half of a pair whose `-execute` sibling is a CHARACTERIZATION fixture. This half is ALREADY CORRECT today and is expected to survive the fix UNCHANGED — it is precisely the answer the run path never consults, which is the whole of saga #811's shape-A mechanism. Fault shape A — an UNRESOLVABLE NAME in argument position. `check()` computes the right answer (`ol-unknown-command`, whose usual stage is `semantic` per spec/error-model.md:97) and `execute()` never consults it, so the statement is discarded whole with no diagnostic and no effect. One diagnostic, on the recursive call's argument. NOTE on provenance: this is NOT the maintainer's `PLANT` fractal that issue #816 item 3 names — that source is not in this repository, so its inherited 5-vs-6,253 draw-segment numbers are asserted nowhere in this slice. This is a minimal recursive tree written for this fixture, and every number its `-execute` sibling asserts was measured from it.
